_comment: Regexes stripped from a synced row's payee, in order, first match only.
An entry is either a bare pattern or an object with a note; see
enable_banking.clean_label. Measured on the production ledger: the two
patterns this list started with rebuilt 70.1% of the labels Alex had
renamed by taking an extract of the bank's wording, and these eleven
rebuild 97.0% of them. New imports only — an existing row is never
rewritten, and raw_label always keeps the bank's full wording.

label_cleanup_patterns.note: Card payment, one or two dates: 'CARTE 18/09 ', 'CARTE 21/09/26 ', 'PAIEMENT CARTE 18/09 18/09 '
Card payment naming the card first: 'CARTE X7092 11/03 '
Cancellation or credit note, with or without a date: 'ANN CARTE ', 'AVOIR 14/04/26 '
Bare card marker some banks put in front of the merchant
Direct debit: 'PRLV ', 'PRLV SEPA ', 'PRLV SEPA RECU RCUR '
Direct debit carrying its mandate number: 'PRELEVEMENT 8060628865 '
Masked card-number suffix: ' CB N° 4971 60XX XXXX 3735'
